headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.88
summary: Skips preloader menu-state hooks when nothing needs them and hardens the overlay visibility debounce against alternating hook flapping.

items.text: Preloader menu-state hooks are no longer installed when the mod menu is disabled and no native mods are loaded — with nothing to poll, the game runs without injected hooks (matches vanilla behavior).
Overlay visibility debounce now also collapses pending state when flags return to the applied value, so alternating single-tick hook flapping can no longer apply visibility changes every few ticks.
